intentEvidence: Monorepo bringing Discord-style Markdown formatting (||spoiler|| and -# subtext) to Obsidian, MDX / Next.js, and platform-independent parsers.
problem: Users want to utilize specific Discord markdown conventions, such as spoilers and subtext, within their Obsidian notes.
summary: Markdown formatting extension that implements Discord-style spoiler (||spoiler||) and subtext (-# subtext) syntax in Obsidian.
